newsitem.title: UK: Northern Rock sees shares at 260 to 295p.
newsitem.headline: Northern Rock sees shares at 260 to 295p.

text.p: Northern Rock Building Society said on Monday 900,000 of its members will get 500 free shares when the society floats on the stock exchange later this year.
The estimated market price of the shares will be between 260p and 295p, valuing the society at a maximum of 1.3 billion pounds ($2.1 billion).
The value of the shares will be between 1,300 and 1,475 pounds based on if the Society had floated on February 7. The actual flotation day is now expected to be October 1.
The Newcastle-based Northern Rock said it will also pay a statutory cash bonus of around 8.8 percent of the balances held in accounts as at December 31, 1996.
Adam Applegarth, Northern Rock executive director said the society could remain independent and would grow organically.

He said the Northern Rock foundation has been asked to pay a donation of one million pounds to disabled charities to compensate for the loss of benefit from the flotation to those disabled members who are second-named on accounts and do not get shares.
